description: “A Wake County grandmother and substitute teacher detained by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement will be released on bond while her immigration case continues. An immigration judge in Georgia ruled Tuesday that Venkata Vasamsetty can be released from federal custody on a $7,500 bond after spending more than two weeks in an ICE detention facility. […]
